---
title: "02 -- Describe and plan"
---

Descriptive tables show denominators and missingness and never perform
inferential tests. Figures use the project figure policy: viridis for
continuous scales, colour-blind-flagged RColorBrewer palettes for categories,
redundant shapes, and patchwork panel assembly. Colour-vision simulations are
recorded as checks, not as guarantees.

Real-data models remain disabled until mappings and scientific prerequisites
are reviewed. The synthetic demonstration is not an analysis of this project.

```{r workflow-descriptives}
file <- "../output/tables/descriptives.csv"
if (file.exists(file)) {
  knitr::kable(utils::read.csv(file, check.names = FALSE), caption = "Study-data descriptives")
} else {
  cat("No study-data workflow output yet.\n")
}
```
